subject.title: fix(sandbox): repair fs bridge stat for Codex exec-server native writes

question: After a narrow rebase, should OpenClaw accept corrected read-only stat classification at the Docker sandbox boundary for the experimental Codex exec-server path?
rationale: The remaining choice is whether the rebased boundary behavior and its fresh proof preserve the intended fail-closed sandbox contract; source review alone should not make that security-sensitive acceptance decision.

options.title: Rebase and review the narrow repair
options.body: Resolve the main conflict, preserve existing path-safety guards, and have the sandbox owner review fresh real Docker proof.

options.title: Pause the experimental path
options.body: Keep the current fail-closed behavior until the sandbox owner decides whether this exec-server write workflow should remain supported.

recommendation.title: Rebase and review the narrow repair
recommendation.body: Resolve the main conflict, preserve existing path-safety guards, and have the sandbox owner review fresh real Docker proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Introduced the sandbox exec-server contract and is the strongest evidence-backed routing candidate for its boundary behavior.
